title: FTI Capital Advisors Supports Aspen Medical on the Sale of UAE Operations to PureHealth

# FTI Capital Advisors Supports Aspen Medical on the Sale of Six Clinics to PureHealth


Abu Dhabi, 16 November 2026 — FTI Capital Advisors DIFC Limited (“FTICA Dubai”), a wholly owned subsidiary of FTI Consulting, Inc. (NYSE: FCN), acted as exclusive strategic and financial advisor to Aspen Medical in the sale of six primary healthcare clinics located in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain to SEHA, a subsidiary of PureHealth group.


The transaction comprises several assets across the country in key locations. Upon completion, the clinics will become part of SEHA clinics, expanding healthcare coverage across residential areas in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain and supporting the emirate’s evolving community healthcare needs, while enhancing access to care for patients and communities


[Fede Membrillera](https://www.fticonsulting.com/experts/federico-membrillera) , Global Co-Leader of FTI Capital Advisors, said, “This is an important transaction for Aspen Medical and the broader healthcare landscape in the UAE. We worked closely with the Aspen Medical team throughout the process, providing strategic and financial advice to help deliver a successful outcome.”


**About FTI Capital Advisors**
[FTI Capital Advisors](https://www.fticapitaladvisors.com/) (“FTICA”) is a global M&A advisory firm with offices in 13 countries, focused on M&A, equity and debt raising and independent financial advisory, across targeted industry sectors – including telecom, media and technology, as well as in the energy, financial services, healthcare, aviation & aerospace, industrials and insurance. Backed by the power of FTI Consulting’s worldwide network of professionals, FTICA combines deep industry expertise with investment banking and transaction execution experience to deliver value-enhancing outcomes for our clients. FTI Capital Advisors globally is the wholly owned investment banking subsidiary of FTI Consulting, Inc.


The transaction was supported by FTI Capital Advisors (DIFC) Limited (“FTICA Dubai”), an affiliate of FTICA. FTICA Dubai is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (“DFSA”), the financial regulatory agency of the special economic zone, the Dubai International Financial Centre (“DIFC”), in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. FTICA Dubai is authorized to provide services to Professional Clients only; accordingly, this press release is intended for Professional Clients only, and no other person should act upon it.
